content_zh:
“坐！”不算强硬也不算温和的声音。
心语僵直着身子坐下，心里猜想着婆婆这么急召她回来是为了什么事。
顾老夫人慢慢啜了口茶，“少卿最近怎么样？”
“很好！”她答得有些心虚，一年几乎见不到他几面，对他近况的了解最多来源于各大娱乐八卦，想来他应该过得很好吧！
顾老夫人扬手，一叠报纸落在她面前，“这就是你所谓的‘很好’？”脸上最后一点慈祥消失殆尽，双眸紧紧盯着她。
‘豪门阔少深夜飚豪车，追逐游戏玩进医院！’大标题赫然印入眼帘，几乎了占了整个版面。
心语瞪大眼睛，报纸上银色莲花跑车车牌号拍得特别清楚，她整个人从沙发弹起来，“少卿！”手攥紧报纸，“妈，少卿现在在哪儿，他怎么样？”
“少卿真有什么事，你还能这么舒服地坐在这儿吗？”顾老夫人脸色阴沉，冷冷开口，“顾家娶你进门不是作摆设用的，你自己看看，从你进门开始，少卿在外面胡闹变本加厉，丈夫出事你都不知道，你是怎么为人妻的？如果你没本事抓住老公的心，趁早出声，想进顾家大门的女人多的是！”顾老夫人越说越难听。
心语低头，轻咬着唇，她现在心里只想着少卿伤得严不严重，只想马上看到他，根本没心思听顾老夫人的教训。
顾老夫人见她低眉顺眼委委屈屈的样子，倒衬得她像个恶婆婆了，喝了口茶顺气，强硬开口，“尽快要个孩子，有了孩子，男人才会收心！”
心语的脸微微变白，“少卿……很忙，我也……还没准备好……”
“啪！”茶杯重重落在茶几上，顾老夫人脸沉得厉害，“是还没准备好？还是根本怀不上？”
心语的唇咬得惨白，“妈，我担心少卿，改天再来看您！”说完，还没等顾老夫人反应，径直出去。
“顾家可不要不会下蛋的‘鸡’！”顾老夫人含怒的声音在她身后响起，刺透耳膜。
上车，用最快的速度离开这座大宅，风在耳边霍霍吹着，明明没流过眼泪，眼睛却有哭过的干涩，干涩得生疼。
‘孩子！女人最幸福的事就是为深爱的男人生孩子，天知道她多么渴望要一个她和他的孩子，可是她不能要，准确说是她不敢要！’
眼眶泛起潮意，那种熟悉的液体开始蔓延，肆无忌惮……
没有爱的‘坟墓’，困住她一个就够了，绝对不能扯上孩子！

content_en:
"Sit!" A voice that was neither strong nor gentle.
Xinyu sat down stiffly, wondering why her mother-in-law had summoned her back so urgently.
Mrs. Gu slowly sipped her tea and asked, "How is Shaoqing doing lately?"
"Very good!" She answered with a guilty conscience. She barely saw him a few times a year, and the most information she knew about his current situation came from major entertainment gossips. I guess he must be living a good life!
Madam Gu raised her hand, and a stack of newspapers fell in front of her, "Is this what you call 'very good'?" The last bit of kindness on her face disappeared, and her eyes stared at her closely.
‘A young man from a rich family drives a luxury car late at night, playing chase games and ends up in the hospital! ’ The big headline suddenly came into view, almost taking up the entire page.
Xinyu's eyes widened. The license plate number of the silver Lotus sports car was very clear on the newspaper. She jumped up from the sofa and asked, "Shaoqing!" She clenched the newspaper tightly, "Mom, where is Shaoqing now? How is he?"
"What's really wrong with Shaoqing? How can you still sit here so comfortably?" Mrs. Gu's face was gloomy and she said coldly, "The Gu family didn't marry you for decoration. See for yourself. Since you entered, Shaoqing's mischief outside has gotten worse. You don't even know what happened to your husband. How did you become a wife? If you don't have the ability to catch your husband's heart and speak out as soon as possible, there will be many women who want to enter the Gu family's door!" Mrs. Gu said more and more ugly.
Xinyu lowered her head and bit her lip. She was only thinking about whether Shaoqing was seriously injured and wanted to see him right away. She had no intention of listening to Mrs. Gu's lecture.
Mrs. Gu saw her lowered eyebrows and submissive look, which made her look like an evil mother-in-law. She took a sip of tea to calm down and said forcefully, "Have a child as soon as possible. Only after you have a child will men stop caring!"
Xinyu's face turned pale slightly, "Shaoqing... is very busy, and I... am not ready yet..."
"Pah!" The teacup fell heavily on the coffee table, and Mrs. Gu's face darkened. "Are you not ready yet? Or you can't get pregnant at all?"
Xinyu bit her lips until they turned pale, "Mom, I'm worried about Shaoqing. I'll come see you another day!" After saying that, Mrs. Gu went straight out before she could react.
"The Gu family doesn't want chickens that can't lay eggs!" Mrs. Gu's angry voice sounded behind her, piercing her eardrums.
Get in the car and leave the mansion as fast as possible, with the wind blowing in your ears. Although you have not shed any tears, your eyes are as dry as crying, so dry that it hurts.
'child! The happiest thing for a woman is to give birth to a child for the man she loves deeply. God knows how much she longs for a child for her and him, but she can't have it. To be precise, she doesn't dare to have it! ’
There was moisture in the eyes, and the familiar liquid began to spread unscrupulously...
There is no 'grave' of love. It is enough to trap her alone, but the child must not be involved!
